name: long_text
text: The quarterly compliance review covered several incidents. On 3 February 2024, an employee named Thomas Weber accidentally shared a spreadsheet containing customer records with an external vendor based in Frankfurt. The file included names such as Julia Schneider and Marco Ferrari, together with their email addresses julia.schneider@example.de and marco.ferrari@example.it, and phone numbers +49 170 5551234 and +39 328 7654321. The data protection officer, Anna Kowalski, opened an investigation on 5 February 2024 and reported the breach to the supervisory authority within the statutory seventy-two hour window. Remediation included revoking the vendor's access, rotating the affected credentials, and retraining the finance team in Frankfurt and Milan.
